translations.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
translations.ylt: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, through the will of God, and Timotheus the brother, to the assembly of God that is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:
translations.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

translations.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ!
translations.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
translations.ylt: Blessed is God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of the mercies, and God of all comfort,
translations.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

translations.kjv: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
translations.ylt: who is comforting us in all our tribulation, for our being able to comfort those in any tribulation through the comfort with which we are comforted ourselves by God;
translations.web: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

translations.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
translations.ylt: because, as the sufferings of the Christ do abound to us, so through the Christ doth abound also our comfort;
translations.web: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

translations.kjv: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
translations.ylt: and whether we be in tribulation, it is for your comfort and salvation, that is wrought in the enduring of the same sufferings that we also suffer; whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort and salvation;
translations.web: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

translations.kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
translations.ylt: and our hope is stedfast for you, knowing that even as ye are partakers of the sufferings--so also of the comfort.
translations.web: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

translations.kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
translations.ylt: For we do not wish you to be ignorant, brethren, of our tribulation that happened to us in Asia, that we were exceedingly burdened above our power, so that we despaired even of life;
translations.web: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

translations.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
translations.ylt: but we ourselves in ourselves the sentence of the death have had, that we may not be trusting on ourselves, but on God, who is raising the dead,
translations.web: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

translations.kjv: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
translations.ylt: who out of so great a death did deliver us, and doth deliver, in whom we have hoped that even yet He will deliver;
translations.web: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

translations.kjv: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
translations.ylt: ye working together also for us by your supplication, that the gift through many persons to us, through many may be thankfully acknowledged for us.
translations.web: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

translations.kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
translations.ylt: For our glorying is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom, but in the grace of God, we did conduct ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you;
translations.web: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

translations.kjv: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
translations.ylt: for no other things do we write to you, but what ye either do read or also acknowledge, and I hope that also unto the end ye shall acknowledge,
translations.web: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

translations.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
translations.ylt: according as also ye did acknowledge us in part, that your glory we are, even as also ye are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus;
translations.web: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

translations.kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
translations.ylt: and in this confidence I was purposing to come unto you before, that a second favour ye might have,
translations.web: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

translations.kjv: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judea.
translations.ylt: and through you to pass to Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come unto you, and by you to be sent forward to Judea.
translations.web: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

translations.kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
translations.ylt: This, therefore, counselling, did I then use the lightness; or the things that I counsel, according to the flesh do I counsel, that it may be with me Yes, yes, and No, no?
translations.web: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

translations.kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
translations.ylt: and God is faithful, that our word unto you became not Yes and No,
translations.web: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

translations.kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
translations.ylt: for the Son of God, Jesus Christ, among you through us having been preached--through me and Silvanus and Timotheus--did not become Yes and No, but in him it hath become Yes;
translations.web: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

translations.kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
translations.ylt: for as many as are promises of God, in him are the Yes, and in him the Amen, for glory to God through us;
translations.web: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

translations.kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
translations.ylt: and He who is confirming you with us into Christ, and did anoint us, is God,
translations.web: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

translations.kjv: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
translations.ylt: who also sealed us, and gave the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
translations.web: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

translations.kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
translations.ylt: And I for a witness on God do call upon my soul, that sparing you, I came not yet to Corinth;
translations.web: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

translations.kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
translations.ylt: not that we are lords over your faith, but we are workers together with your joy, for by the faith ye stand.
translations.web: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

translations.kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
translations.ylt: And I decided this to myself, not again to come in sorrow unto you,
translations.web: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

translations.kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
translations.ylt: for if I make you sorry, then who is he who is making me glad, except he who is made sorry by me?
translations.web: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

translations.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
translations.ylt: and I wrote to you this same thing, that having come, I may not have sorrow from them of whom it behoved me to have joy, having confidence in you all, that my joy is of you all,
translations.web: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

translations.kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
translations.ylt: for out of much tribulation and pressure of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not that ye might be made sorry, but that ye might know the love that I have more abundantly toward you.
translations.web: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

translations.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
translations.ylt: And if any one hath caused sorrow, he hath not caused sorrow to me, but in part, that I may not burden you all;
translations.web: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

translations.kjv: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
translations.ylt: sufficient to such a one is this punishment, that is by the more part,
translations.web: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

translations.kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
translations.ylt: so that, on the contrary, it is rather for you to forgive and to comfort, lest by over abundant sorrow such a one may be swallowed up;
translations.web: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
translations.ylt: wherefore, I call upon you to confirm love to him,
translations.web: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

translations.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
translations.ylt: for, for this also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether in regard to all things ye are obedient.
translations.web: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

translations.kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
translations.ylt: And to whom ye forgive anything--I also; for I also, if I have forgiven anything, to whom I have forgiven it, because of you--in the person of Christ-- I forgive it,
translations.web: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

translations.kjv: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
translations.ylt: that we may not be over-reached by the Adversary, for of his devices we are not ignorant.
translations.web: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

translations.kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
translations.ylt: And having come to Troas for the good news of the Christ, and a door to me having been opened in the Lord,
translations.web: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

translations.kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
translations.ylt: I have not had rest to my spirit, on my not finding Titus my brother, but having taken leave of them, I went forth to Macedonia;
translations.web: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

translations.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
translations.ylt: and to God are thanks, who at all times is leading us in triumph in the Christ, and the fragrance of His knowledge He is manifesting through us in every place,
translations.web: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

translations.kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
translations.ylt: because of Christ a sweet fragrance we are to God, in those being saved, and in those being lost;
translations.web: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

translations.kjv: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
translations.ylt: to the one, indeed, a fragrance of death to death, and to the other, a fragrance of life to life; and for these things who is sufficient?
translations.web: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

translations.kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
translations.ylt: for we are not as the many, adulterating the word of God, but as of sincerity--but as of God; in the presence of God, in Christ we do speak.
translations.web: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

translations.kjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
translations.ylt: Do we begin again to recommend ourselves, except we need, as some, letters of recommendation unto you, or from you?
translations.web: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

translations.kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
translations.ylt: our letter ye are, having been written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
translations.web: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

translations.kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
translations.ylt: manifested that ye are a letter of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God, not in the tablets of stone, but in fleshy tablets of the heart,
translations.web: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

translations.kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
translations.ylt: and such trust we have through the Christ toward God,
translations.web: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

translations.kjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
translations.ylt: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think anything, as of ourselves, but our sufficiency is of God,
translations.web: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

translations.kjv: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
translations.ylt: who also made us sufficient to be ministrants of a new covenant, not of letter, but of spirit; for the letter doth kill, and the spirit doth make alive.
translations.web: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

translations.kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
translations.ylt: and if the ministration of the death, in letters, engraved in stones, came in glory, so that the sons of Israel were not able to look stedfastly to the face of Moses, because of the glory of his face--which was being made useless,
translations.web: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

translations.kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
translations.ylt: how shall the ministration of the Spirit not be more in glory?
translations.web: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

translations.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
translations.ylt: for if the ministration of the condemnation is glory, much more doth the ministration of the righteousness abound in glory;
translations.web: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

translations.kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
translations.ylt: for also even that which hath been glorious, hath not been glorious--in this respect, because of the superior glory;
translations.web: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

translations.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
translations.ylt: for if that which is being made useless is through glory, much more that which is remaining is in glory.
translations.web: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

translations.kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
translations.ylt: Having, then, such hope, we use much freedom of speech,
translations.web: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

translations.kjv: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
translations.ylt: and are not as Moses, who was putting a vail upon his own face, for the sons of Israel not stedfastly to look to the end of that which is being made useless,
translations.web: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

translations.kjv: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
translations.ylt: but their minds were hardened, for unto this day the same vail at the reading of the Old Covenant doth remain unwithdrawn--which in Christ is being made useless--
translations.web: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

translations.kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
translations.ylt: but till to-day, when Moses is read, a vail upon their heart doth lie,
translations.web: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
translations.ylt: and whenever they may turn unto the Lord, the vail is taken away.
translations.web: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

translations.kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
translations.ylt: And the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty;
translations.web: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

translations.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
translations.ylt: and we all, with unvailed face, the glory of the Lord beholding in a mirror, to the same image are being transformed, from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
translations.web: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

translations.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
translations.ylt: Because of this, having this ministration, according as we did receive kindness, we do not faint,
translations.web: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

translations.kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
translations.ylt: but did renounce for ourselves the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor deceitfully using the word of God, but by the manifestation of the truth recommending ourselves unto every conscience of men, before God;
translations.web: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

translations.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
translations.ylt: and if also our good news is vailed, in those perishing it is vailed,
translations.web: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

translations.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
translations.ylt: in whom the god of this age did blind the minds of the unbelieving, that there doth not shine forth to them the enlightening of the good news of the glory of the Christ, who is the image of God;
translations.web: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

translations.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
translations.ylt: for not ourselves do we preach, but Christ Jesus--Lord, and ourselves your servants because of Jesus;
translations.web: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

translations.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: because it is God who said, Out of darkness light is to shine, who did shine in our hearts, for the enlightening of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
translations.web: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
translations.ylt: And we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us;
translations.web: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

translations.kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
translations.ylt: on every side being in tribulation, but not straitened; perplexed, but not in despair;
translations.web: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

translations.kjv: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
translations.ylt: persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
translations.web: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

translations.kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
translations.ylt: at all times the dying of the Lord Jesus bearing about in the body, that the life also of Jesus in our body may be manifested,
translations.web: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

translations.kjv: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
translations.ylt: for always are we who are living delivered up to death because of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our dying flesh,
translations.web: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

translations.kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
translations.ylt: so that, the death indeed in us doth work, and the life in you.
translations.web: So then death works in us, but life in you.

translations.kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
translations.ylt: And having the same spirit of the faith, according to that which hath been written, `I believed, therefore I did speak;' we also do believe, therefore also do we speak;
translations.web: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

translations.kjv: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
translations.ylt: knowing that He who did raise up the Lord Jesus, us also through Jesus shall raise up, and shall present with you,
translations.web: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

translations.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
translations.ylt: for the all things are because of you, that the grace having been multiplied, because of the thanksgiving of the more, may abound to the glory of God;
translations.web: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

translations.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
translations.ylt: wherefore, we faint not, but if also our outward man doth decay, yet the inward is renewed day by day;
translations.web: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

translations.kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
translations.ylt: for the momentary light matter of our tribulation, more and more exceedingly an age-during weight of glory doth work out for us--
translations.web: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

translations.kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
translations.ylt: we not looking to the things seen, but to the things not seen; for the things seen are temporary, but the things not seen are age-during.
translations.web: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

translations.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
translations.ylt: For we have known that if our earthly house of the tabernacle may be thrown down, a building from God we have, an house not made with hands--age-during--in the heavens,
translations.web: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

translations.kjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
translations.ylt: for also in this we groan, with our dwelling that is from heaven earnestly desiring to clothe ourselves,
translations.web: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

translations.kjv: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
translations.ylt: if so be that, having clothed ourselves, we shall not be found naked,
translations.web: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

translations.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
translations.ylt: for we also who are in the tabernacle do groan, being burdened, seeing we wish not to unclothe ourselves, but to clothe ourselves, that the mortal may be swallowed up of the life.
translations.web: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

translations.kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
translations.ylt: And He who did work us to this self-same thing is God, who also did give to us the earnest of the Spirit;
translations.web: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

translations.kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
translations.ylt: having courage, then, at all times, and knowing that being at home in the body, we are away from home from the Lord, --
translations.web: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

translations.kjv: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
translations.ylt: for through faith we walk, not through sight--
translations.web: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

translations.kjv: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
translations.ylt: we have courage, and are well pleased rather to be away from the home of the body, and to be at home with the Lord.
translations.web: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

translations.kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
translations.ylt: Wherefore also we are ambitious, whether at home or away from home, to be well pleasing to him,
translations.web: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

translations.kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
translations.ylt: for all of us it behoveth to be manifested before the tribunal of the Christ, that each one may receive the things done through the body, in reference to the things that he did, whether good or evil;
translations.web: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

translations.kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
translations.ylt: having known, therefore, the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, and to God we are manifested, and I hope also in your consciences to have been manifested;
translations.web: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

translations.kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
translations.ylt: for not again ourselves do we recommend to you, but we are giving occasion to you of glorifying in our behalf, that ye may have something in reference to those glorifying in face and not in heart;
translations.web: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

translations.kjv: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
translations.ylt: for whether we were beside ourselves, it was to God; whether we be of sound mind-- it is to you,
translations.web: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

translations.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
translations.ylt: for the love of the Christ doth constrain us, having judged thus: that if one for all died, then the whole died,
translations.web: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

translations.kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
translations.ylt: and for all he died, that those living, no more to themselves may live, but to him who died for them, and was raised again.
translations.web: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

translations.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
translations.ylt: So that we henceforth have known no one according to the flesh, and even if we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him no more;
translations.web: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

translations.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
translations.ylt: so that if any one is in Christ-- he is a new creature; the old things did pass away, lo, become new have the all things.
translations.web: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

translations.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
translations.ylt: And the all things are of God, who reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and did give to us the ministration of the reconciliation,
translations.web: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

translations.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
translations.ylt: how that God was in Christ--a world reconciling to Himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses; and having put in us the word of the reconciliation,
translations.web: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

translations.kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
translations.ylt: in behalf of Christ, then, we are ambassadors, as if God were calling through us, we beseech, in behalf of Christ, `Be ye reconciled to God;'
translations.web: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

translations.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
translations.ylt: for him who did not know sin, in our behalf He did make sin, that we may become the righteousness of God in him.
translations.web: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

translations.kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
translations.ylt: And working together also we call upon you that ye receive not in vain the grace of God--
translations.web: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

translations.kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
translations.ylt: for He saith, `In an acceptable time I did hear thee, and in a day of salvation I did help thee, lo, now is a well-accepted time; lo, now, a day of salvation,' --
translations.web: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

translations.kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
translations.ylt: in nothing giving any cause of offence, that the ministration may be not blamed,
translations.web: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

translations.kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
translations.ylt: but in everything recommending ourselves as God's ministrants; in much patience, in tribulations, in necessities, in distresses,
translations.web: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

translations.kjv: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
translations.ylt: in stripes, in imprisonments, in insurrections, in labours, in watchings, in fastings,
translations.web: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

translations.kjv: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
translations.ylt: in pureness, in knowledge, in long-suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,
translations.web: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

translations.kjv: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
translations.ylt: in the word of truth, in the power of God, through the armour of the righteousness, on the right and on the left,
translations.web: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

translations.kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
translations.ylt: through glory and dishonour, through evil report and good report, as leading astray, and true;
translations.web: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

translations.kjv: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
translations.ylt: as unknown, and recognized; as dying, and lo, we live; as chastened, and not put to death;
translations.web: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

translations.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
translations.ylt: as sorrowful, and always rejoicing; as poor, and making many rich; as having nothing, and possessing all things.
translations.web: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

translations.kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
translations.ylt: Our mouth hath been open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart hath been enlarged!
translations.web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

translations.kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
translations.ylt: ye are not straitened in us, and ye are straitened in your own bowels,
translations.web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

translations.kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
translations.ylt: and as a recompense of the same kind, (as to children I say it,) be ye enlarged--also ye!
translations.web: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

translations.kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
translations.ylt: Become not yoked with others--unbelievers, for what partaking is there to righteousness and lawlessness?
translations.web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

translations.kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
translations.ylt: and what fellowship to light with darkness? and what concord to Christ with Belial? or what part to a believer with an unbeliever?
translations.web: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

translations.kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
translations.ylt: and what agreement to the sanctuary of God with idols? for ye are a sanctuary of the living God, according as God said--`I will dwell in them, and will walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be My people,
translations.web: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

translations.kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
translations.ylt: wherefore, come ye forth out of the midst of them, and be separated, saith the Lord, and an unclean thing do not touch, and I--I will receive you,
translations.web: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

translations.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
translations.ylt: and I will be to you for a Father, and ye--ye shall be to Me for sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.'
translations.web: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

translations.kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
translations.ylt: Having, then, these promises, beloved, may we cleanse ourselves from every pollution of flesh and spirit, perfecting sanctification in the fear of God;
translations.web: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

translations.kjv: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
translations.ylt: receive us; no one did we wrong; no one did we waste; no one did we defraud;
translations.web: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

translations.kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
translations.ylt: not to condemn you do I say it, for I have said before that in our hearts ye are to die with and to live with;
translations.web: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

translations.kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
translations.ylt: great is my freedom of speech unto you, great my glory on your behalf; I have been filled with the comfort, I overabound with the joy on all our tribulation,
translations.web: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

translations.kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
translations.ylt: for also we, having come to Macedonia, no relaxation hath our flesh had, but on every side we are in tribulation, without are fightings, within--fears;
translations.web: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
translations.ylt: but He who is comforting the cast-down--God--He did comfort us in the presence of Titus;
translations.web: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

translations.kjv: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
translations.ylt: and not only in his presence, but also in the comfort with which he was comforted over you, declaring to us your longing desire, your lamentation, your zeal for me, so that the more I did rejoice,
translations.web: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

translations.kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
translations.ylt: because even if I made you sorry in the letter, I do not repent--if even I did repent--for I perceive that the letter, even if for an hour, did make you sorry.
translations.web: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

translations.kjv: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
translations.ylt: I now do rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye were made sorry to reformation, for ye were made sorry toward God, that in nothing ye might receive damage from us;
translations.web: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

translations.kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
translations.ylt: for the sorrow toward God reformation to salvation not to be repented of doth work, and the sorrow of the world doth work death,
translations.web: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

translations.kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
translations.ylt: for, lo, this same thing--your being made sorry toward God--how much diligence it doth work in you! but defence, but displeasure, but fear, but longing desire, but zeal, but revenge; in every thing ye did approve yourselves to be pure in the matter.
translations.web: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
translations.ylt: If, then, I also wrote to you--not for his cause who did wrong, nor for his cause who did suffer wrong, but for our diligence in your behalf being manifested unto you before God--
translations.web: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

translations.kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
translations.ylt: because of this we have been comforted in your comfort, and more abundantly the more did we rejoice in the joy of Titus, that his spirit hath been refreshed from you all;
translations.web: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

translations.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
translations.ylt: because if anything to him in your behalf I have boasted, I was not put to shame; but as all things in truth we did speak to you, so also our boasting before Titus became truth,
translations.web: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

translations.kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
translations.ylt: and his tender affection is more abundantly toward you, remembering the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye did receive him;
translations.web: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

translations.kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
translations.ylt: I rejoice, therefore, that in everything I have courage in you.
translations.web: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

translations.kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
translations.ylt: And we make known to you, brethren, the grace of God, that hath been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
translations.web: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

translations.kjv: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
translations.ylt: because in much trial of tribulation the abundance of their joy, and their deep poverty, did abound to the riches of their liberality;
translations.web: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

translations.kjv: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
translations.ylt: because, according to their power, I testify, and above their power, they were willing of themselves,
translations.web: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

translations.kjv: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
translations.ylt: with much entreaty calling on us to receive the favour and the fellowship of the ministration to the saints,
translations.web: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

translations.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
translations.ylt: and not according as we expected, but themselves they did give first to the Lord, and to us, through the will of God,
translations.web: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

translations.kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
translations.ylt: so that we exhorted Titus, that, according as he did begin before, so also he may finish to you also this favour,
translations.web: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

translations.kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
translations.ylt: but even as in every thing ye do abound, in faith, and word, and knowledge, and all diligence, and in your love to us, that also in this grace ye may abound;
translations.web: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

translations.kjv: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
translations.ylt: not according to command do I speak, but because of the diligence of others, and of your love proving the genuineness,
translations.web: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

translations.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
translations.ylt: for ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that because of you he became poor--being rich, that ye by that poverty may become rich.
translations.web: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

translations.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
translations.ylt: and an opinion in this do I give: for this to you is expedient, who not only to do, but also to will, did begin before--a year ago,
translations.web: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

translations.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
translations.ylt: and now also finish doing it, that even as there is the readiness of the will, so also the finishing, out of that which ye have,
translations.web: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

translations.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
translations.ylt: for if the willing mind is present, according to that which any one may have it is well-accepted, not according to that which he hath not;
translations.web: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

translations.kjv: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
translations.ylt: for not that for others release, and ye pressured, do I speak,
translations.web: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

translations.kjv: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
translations.ylt: but by equality, at the present time your abundance--for their want, that also their abundance may be for your want, that there may be equality,
translations.web: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

translations.kjv: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
translations.ylt: according as it hath been written, `He who did gather much, had nothing over; and he who did gather little, had no lack.'
translations.web: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

translations.kjv: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
translations.ylt: And thanks to God, who is putting the same diligence for you in the heart of Titus,
translations.web: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

translations.kjv: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
translations.ylt: because indeed the exhortation he accepted, and being more diligent, of his own accord he went forth unto you,
translations.web: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

translations.kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
translations.ylt: and we sent with him the brother, whose praise in the good news is through all the assemblies,
translations.web: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

translations.kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
translations.ylt: and not only so, but who was also appointed by vote by the assemblies, our fellow-traveller, with this favour that is ministered by us, unto the glory of the same Lord, and your willing mind;
translations.web: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

translations.kjv: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
translations.ylt: avoiding this, lest any one may blame us in this abundance that is ministered by us,
translations.web: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

translations.kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
translations.ylt: providing right things, not only before the Lord, but also before men;
translations.web: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

translations.kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
translations.ylt: and we sent with them our brother, whom we proved in many things many times being diligent, and now much more diligent, by the great confidence that is toward you,
translations.web: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

translations.kjv: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
translations.ylt: whether--about Titus--my partner and towards you fellow-worker, whether--our brethren, apostles of assemblies--glory of Christ;
translations.web: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

translations.kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
translations.ylt: the shewing therefore of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf, to them shew ye, even in the face of the assemblies.
translations.web: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

translations.kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
translations.ylt: For, indeed, concerning the ministration that is for the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you,
translations.web: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

translations.kjv: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
translations.ylt: for I have known your readiness of mind, which in your behalf I boast of to Macedonians, that Achaia hath been prepared a year ago, and the zeal of you did stir up the more part,
translations.web: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

translations.kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
translations.ylt: and I sent the brethren, that our boasting on your behalf may not be made vain in this respect; that, according as I said, ye may be ready,
translations.web: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

translations.kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
translations.ylt: lest if Macedonians may come with me, and find you unprepared, we--we may be put to shame (that we say not--ye) in this same confidence of boasting.
translations.web: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

translations.kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
translations.ylt: Necessary, therefore, I thought it to exhort the brethren, that they may go before to you, and may make up before your formerly announced blessing, that this be ready, as a blessing, and not as covetousness.
translations.web: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

translations.kjv: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
translations.ylt: And this: He who is sowing sparingly, sparingly also shall reap; and he who is sowing in blessings, in blessings also shall reap;
translations.web: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

translations.kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
translations.ylt: each one, according as he doth purpose in heart, not out of sorrow or out of necessity, for a cheerful giver doth God love,
translations.web: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

translations.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
translations.ylt: and God is able all grace to cause to abound to you, that in every thing always all sufficiency having, ye may abound to every good work,
translations.web: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

translations.kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
translations.ylt: (according as it hath been written, `He dispersed abroad, he gave to the poor, his righteousness doth remain to the age,')
translations.web: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

translations.kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
translations.ylt: and may He who is supplying seed to the sower, and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
translations.web: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

translations.kjv: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
translations.ylt: in every thing being enriched to all liberality, which doth work through us thanksgiving to God,
translations.web: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

translations.kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
translations.ylt: because the ministration of this service not only is supplying the wants of the saints, but is also abounding through many thanksgivings to God,
translations.web: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

translations.kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
translations.ylt: through the proof of this ministration glorifying God for the subjection of your confession to the good news of the Christ, and for the liberality of the fellowship to them and to all,
translations.web: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

translations.kjv: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
translations.ylt: and by their supplication in your behalf, longing after you because of the exceeding grace of God upon you;
translations.web: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

translations.kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
translations.ylt: thanks also to God for His unspeakable gift!
translations.web: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

translations.kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
translations.ylt: And I, Paul, myself, do call upon you--through the meekness and gentleness of the Christ--who in presence, indeed am humble among you, and being absent, have courage toward you,
translations.web: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

translations.kjv: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
translations.ylt: and I beseech you, that, being present, I may not have courage, with the confidence with which I reckon to be bold against certain reckoning us as walking according to the flesh;
translations.web: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

translations.kjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
translations.ylt: for walking in the flesh, not according to the flesh do we war,
translations.web: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

translations.kjv: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
translations.ylt: for the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but powerful to God for bringing down of strongholds,
translations.web: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

translations.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
translations.ylt: reasonings bringing down, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ,
translations.web: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

translations.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
translations.ylt: and being in readiness to avenge every disobedience, whenever your obedience may be fulfilled.
translations.web: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

translations.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
translations.ylt: The things in presence do ye see? if any one hath trusted in himself to be Christ's, this let him reckon again from himself, that according as he is Christ's, so also we are Christ's;
translations.web: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

translations.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
translations.ylt: for even if also anything more abundantly I shall boast concerning our authority, that the Lord gave us for building up, and not for casting you down, I shall not be ashamed;
translations.web: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

translations.kjv: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
translations.ylt: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you through the letters,
translations.web: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

translations.kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
translations.ylt: `because the letters indeed--saith one-- are weighty and strong, and the bodily presence weak, and the speech despicable.'
translations.web: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

translations.kjv: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
translations.ylt: This one--let him reckon thus: that such as we are in word, through letters, being absent, such also, being present, we are in deed.
translations.web: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

translations.kjv: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
translations.ylt: For we do not make bold to rank or to compare ourselves with certain of those commending themselves, but they, among themselves measuring themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are not wise,
translations.web: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

translations.kjv: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
translations.ylt: and we in regard to the unmeasured things will not boast ourselves, but after the measure of the line that the God of measure did appoint to us--to reach even unto you;
translations.web: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

translations.kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
translations.ylt: for not as not reaching to you do we stretch ourselves overmuch, for even unto you did we come in the good news of the Christ,
translations.web: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
