translations.kjv: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
translations.ylt: not boasting of the things not measured, in other men's labours, and having hope--your faith increasing--in you to be enlarged, according to our line--into abundance,
translations.web: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

translations.kjv: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
translations.ylt: in the places beyond you to proclaim good news, not in another's line in regard to the things made ready, to boast;
translations.web: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

translations.kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
translations.ylt: and he who is boasting--in the Lord let him boast;
translations.web: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

translations.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
translations.ylt: for not he who is commending himself is approved, but he whom the Lord doth commend.
translations.web: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

translations.kjv: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
translations.ylt: O that ye were bearing with me a little of the folly, but ye also do bear with me:
translations.web: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

translations.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
translations.ylt: for I am zealous for you with zeal of God, for I did betroth you to one husband, a pure virgin, to present to Christ,
translations.web: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

translations.kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
translations.ylt: and I fear, lest, as the serpent did beguile Eve in his subtilty, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in the Christ;
translations.web: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

translations.kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
translations.ylt: for if, indeed, he who is coming doth preach another Jesus whom we did not preach, or another Spirit ye receive which ye did not receive, or other good news which ye did not accept--well were ye bearing it,
translations.web: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

translations.kjv: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
translations.ylt: for I reckon that I have been nothing behind the very chiefest apostles,
translations.web: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

translations.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
translations.ylt: and even if unlearned in word--yet not in knowledge, but in every thing we were made manifest in all things to you.
translations.web: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

translations.kjv: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
translations.ylt: The sin did I do--myself humbling that ye might be exalted, because freely the good news of God I did proclaim to you?
translations.web: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

translations.kjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
translations.ylt: other assemblies I did rob, having taken wages, for your ministration;
translations.web: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

translations.kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
translations.ylt: and being present with you, and having been in want, I was chargeable to no one, for my lack did the brethren supply--having come from Macedonia--and in everything burdenless to you I did keep myself, and will keep.
translations.web: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

translations.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
translations.ylt: The truth of Christ is in me, because this boasting shall not be stopped in regard to me in the regions of Achaia;
translations.web: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

translations.kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
translations.ylt: wherefore? because I do not love you? God hath known!
translations.web: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

translations.kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
translations.ylt: and what I do, I also will do, that I may cut off the occasion of those wishing an occasion, that in that which they boast they may be found according as we also;
translations.web: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

translations.kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
translations.ylt: for those such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ,
translations.web: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

translations.kjv: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
translations.ylt: and no wonder--for even the Adversary doth transform himself into a messenger of light;
translations.web: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

translations.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
translations.ylt: no great thing, then, if also his ministrants do transform themselves as ministrants of righteousness--whose end shall be according to their works.
translations.web: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

translations.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
translations.ylt: Again I say, may no one think me to be a fool; and if otherwise, even as a fool receive me, that I also a little may boast.
translations.web: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

translations.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
translations.ylt: That which I speak, I speak not according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this the confidence of boasting;
translations.web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

translations.kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
translations.ylt: since many boast according to the flesh, I also will boast:
translations.web: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

translations.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
translations.ylt: for gladly do ye bear with the fools--being wise,
translations.web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

translations.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
translations.ylt: for ye bear, if any one is bringing you under bondage, if any one doth devour, if any one doth take away, if any one doth exalt himself, if any one on the face doth smite you;
translations.web: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

translations.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
translations.ylt: in reference to dishonour I speak, how that we were weak, and in whatever any one is bold--in foolishness I say it --I also am bold.
translations.web: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

translations.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
translations.ylt: Hebrews are they? I also! Israelites are they? I also! seed of Abraham are they? I also!
translations.web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

translations.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
translations.ylt: ministrants of Christ are they? --as beside myself I speak--I more; in labours more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequently, in deaths many times;
translations.web: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

translations.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
translations.ylt: from Jews five times forty stripes save one I did receive;
translations.web: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

translations.kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
translations.ylt: thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice was I shipwrecked, a night and a day in the deep I have passed;
translations.web: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

translations.kjv: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
translations.ylt: journeyings many times, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from kindred, perils from nations, perils in city, perils in wilderness, perils in sea, perils among false brethren;
translations.web: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

translations.kjv: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
translations.ylt: in labouriousness and painfulness, in watchings many times, in hunger and thirst, in fastings many times, in cold and nakedness;
translations.web: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

translations.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
translations.ylt: apart from the things without--the crowding upon me that is daily--the care of all the assemblies.
translations.web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

translations.kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
translations.ylt: Who is infirm, and I am not infirm? who is stumbled, and I am not fired;
translations.web: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

translations.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
translations.ylt: if to boast it behoveth me, of the things of my infirmity I will boast;
translations.web: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

translations.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
translations.ylt: the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ--who is blessed to the ages--hath known that I do not lie! --
translations.web: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

translations.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
translations.ylt: In Damascus the ethnarch of Aretas the king was watching the city of the Damascenes, wishing to seize me,
translations.web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

translations.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
translations.ylt: and through a window in a rope basket I was let down, through the wall, and fled out of his hands.
translations.web: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

translations.kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
translations.ylt: To boast, really, is not profitable for me, for I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
translations.web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

translations.kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
translations.ylt: I have known a man in Christ, fourteen years ago--whether in the body I have not known, whether out of the body I have not known, God hath known--such an one being caught away unto the third heaven;
translations.web: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

translations.kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
translations.ylt: and I have known such a man--whether in the body, whether out of the body, I have not known, God hath known, --
translations.web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

translations.kjv: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
translations.ylt: that he was caught away to the paradise, and heard unutterable sayings, that it is not possible for man to speak.
translations.web: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

translations.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
translations.ylt: Of such an one I will boast, and of myself I will not boast, except in my infirmities,
translations.web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

translations.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
translations.ylt: for if I may wish to boast, I shall not be a fool, for truth I will say; but I forebear, lest any one in regard to me may think anything above what he doth see me, or doth hear anything of me;
translations.web: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

translations.kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
translations.ylt: and that by the exceeding greatness of the revelations I might not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of the Adversary, that he might buffet me, that I might not be exalted overmuch.
translations.web: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

translations.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
translations.ylt: Concerning this thing thrice the Lord did I call upon, that it might depart from me,
translations.web: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

translations.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
translations.ylt: and He said to me, `Sufficient for thee is My grace, for My power in infirmity is perfected;' most gladly, therefore, will I rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of the Christ may rest on me:
translations.web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

translations.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
translations.ylt: wherefore I am well pleased in infirmities, in damages, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses--for Christ; for whenever I am infirm, then I am powerful;
translations.web: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

translations.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
translations.ylt: I have become a fool--boasting; ye--ye did compel me; for I ought by you to have been commended, for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles--even if I am nothing.
translations.web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

translations.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
translations.ylt: The signs, indeed, of the apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds,
translations.web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

translations.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
translations.ylt: for what is there in which ye were inferior to the rest of the assemblies, except that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this injustice!
translations.web: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

translations.kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
translations.ylt: Lo, a third time I am ready to come unto you, and I will not be a burden to you, for I seek not yours, but you, for the children ought not for the parents to lay up, but the parents for the children,
translations.web: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

translations.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
translations.ylt: and I most gladly will spend and be entirely spent for your souls, even if, more abundantly loving you, less I am loved.
translations.web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

translations.kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
translations.ylt: And be it so, I--I did not burden you, but being crafty, with guile I did take you;
translations.web: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

translations.kjv: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
translations.ylt: any one of those whom I have sent unto you--by him did I take advantage of you?
translations.web: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

translations.kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
translations.ylt: I entreated Titus, and did send with him the brother; did Titus take advantage of you? in the same spirit did we not walk? --did we not in the same steps?
translations.web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

translations.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
translations.ylt: Again, think ye that to you we are making defence? before God in Christ do we speak; and the all things, beloved, are for your up-building,
translations.web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

translations.kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
translations.ylt: for I fear lest, having come, not such as I wish I may find you, and I--I may be found by you such as ye do not wish, lest there be strifes, envyings, wraths, revelries, evil-speakings, whisperings, puffings up, insurrections,
translations.web: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

translations.kjv: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
translations.ylt: lest again having come, my God may humble me in regard to you, and I may bewail many of those having sinned before, and not having reformed concerning the uncleanness, and whoredom, and lasciviousness, that they did practise.
translations.web: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

translations.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
translations.ylt: This third time do I come unto you; on the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every saying be established;
translations.web: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

translations.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
translations.ylt: I have said before, and I say it before, as being present, the second time, and being absent, now, do I write to those having sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again, I will not spare,
translations.web: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

translations.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
translations.ylt: since a proof ye seek of the Christ speaking in me, who to you is not infirm, but is powerful in you,
translations.web: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

translations.kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
translations.ylt: for even if he was crucified from infirmity, yet he doth live from the power of God; for we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him from the power of God toward you.
translations.web: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

translations.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
translations.ylt: Your own selves try ye, if ye are in the faith; your own selves prove ye; do ye not know your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, if ye be not in some respect disapproved of?
translations.web: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

translations.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
translations.ylt: and I hope that ye shall know that we--we are not disapproved of;
translations.web: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

translations.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
translations.ylt: and I pray before God that ye do no evil, not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is right, and we may be as disapproved;
translations.web: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

translations.kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
translations.ylt: for we are not able to do anything against the truth, but for the truth;
translations.web: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

translations.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
translations.ylt: for we rejoice when we may be infirm, and ye may be powerful; and this also we pray for--your perfection!
translations.web: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

translations.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
translations.ylt: because of this, these things--being absent--I write, that being present, I may not treat any sharply, according to the authority that the Lord did give me for building up, and not for casting down.
translations.web: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

translations.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
translations.ylt: Henceforth, brethren, rejoice; be made perfect, be comforted, be of the same mind, be at peace, and the God of the love and peace shall be with you;
translations.web: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

translations.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
translations.ylt: salute one another in an holy kiss;
translations.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

translations.kjv: All the saints salute you.
translations.ylt: salute you do all the saints;
translations.web: All the saints greet you.
